import { computed, inject, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { useDnD } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Glyph, { type GlyphName } from './Glyph.vue';
import { DRIVE } from './drive';
import { isFolder } from './files';

/**
 * The menu of a right click, Shift+F10 or the toolbar's "More": for the selection, or for
 * the open folder when nothing is selected. Arrows move, Enter picks, Escape closes.
 */
const drive = inject(DRIVE)!;
const { selection } = useDnD();

interface Item {
  label: string;
  glyph: GlyphName;
  run: () => void;
  keys?: string;
  danger?: boolean;
}

const groups = computed((): Item[][] => {
  const picked = drive.selected.value;
  const one = picked.length === 1 ? picked[0]! : null;
  const folder = one && isFolder(one) ? one : null;
  const info: Item = { label: 'Get Info', glyph: 'info', run: () => (drive.info.value = true) };

  if (drive.inTrash.value) {
    if (!picked.length) {
      return drive.trash.value.children.length ? [[{ label: 'Empty Trash', glyph: 'trash', danger: true, run: drive.emptyTrash }]] : [[info]];
    }
    return [
      [{ label: 'Put Back', glyph: 'restore', run: () => drive.putBack(picked) }, info],
      [{ label: 'Delete Forever', glyph: 'trash', keys: 'Del', danger: true, run: () => drive.deleteForever(picked) }],
    ];
  }
  if (!picked.length) {
    return [
      [{ label: 'New Folder', glyph: 'folder-plus', run: drive.newFolder }],
      [
        { label: 'Select All', glyph: 'select', keys: 'Ctrl A', run: () => selection.set(drive.entries.value.map((entry) => entry.id)) },
        drive.view.value === 'grid'
          ? { label: 'View as List', glyph: 'list', run: () => (drive.view.value = 'list') }
          : { label: 'View as Grid', glyph: 'grid', run: () => (drive.view.value = 'grid') },
        info,
      ],
    ];
  }
  return [
    [...(folder ? [{ label: 'Open', glyph: 'open', keys: 'Enter', run: () => drive.open(folder) } as Item] : []), info],
    [
      ...(one ? [{ label: 'Rename', glyph: 'pencil', keys: 'F2', run: () => (drive.renaming.value = one.id) } as Item] : []),
      { label: 'Duplicate', glyph: 'copy', run: () => drive.duplicate(picked) },
      ...(folder
        ? [{ label: drive.isFavorite(folder) ? 'Remove from Favorites' : 'Add to Favorites', glyph: 'star', run: () => drive.toggleFavorite(folder) } as Item]
        : []),
    ],
    [{ label: 'Move to Trash', glyph: 'trash', keys: 'Del', danger: true, run: () => drive.moveToTrash(picked) }],
  ];
});

// ─── Placing it, focus, closing ──────────────────────────────────────────────

const menu = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('menu');
/** In the window's coordinates, kept inside it: the menu opens up or left near its edges. */
const place = ref({ left: '0px', top: '0px' });
/** What had the focus: it gets it back when the menu closes. */
const opener = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;

const close = () => {
  drive.menu.value = null;
  if (opener?.isConnected) opener.focus();
};
const run = (item: Item) => {
  close();
  item.run();
};

const buttons = () => [...(menu.value?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="menuitem"]') ?? [])];
const onKeydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  const all = buttons();
  const at = all.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
  const next = { ArrowDown: at + 1, ArrowUp: at - 1, Home: 0, End: all.length - 1 }[event.key];
  if (next !== undefined) {
    event.preventDefault();
    all[(next + all.length) % all.length]?.focus();
  } else if (event.key === 'Escape' || event.key === 'Tab') {
    event.preventDefault();
    close();
  }
};

// A press anywhere else closes it.
const onPointerdown = (event: PointerEvent) => {
  if (!menu.value?.contains(event.target as Node)) drive.menu.value = null;
};

onMounted(() => {
  const element = menu.value!;
  const frame = (element.offsetParent ?? document.body).getBoundingClientRect();
  const { x, y } = drive.menu.value!;
  const left = x + element.offsetWidth > frame.right - 6 ? x - element.offsetWidth : x;
  const top = y + element.offsetHeight > frame.bottom - 6 ? y - element.offsetHeight : y;
  place.value = {
    left: `${Math.max(6, left - frame.left)}px`,
    top: `${Math.max(6, top - frame.top)}px`,
  };
  buttons()[0]?.focus();
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerdown, true);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerdown, true));
</script>

/** The drive's state and everything that changes it, shared by the parts of the window. */
import { computed, onScopeDispose, ref, shallowRef, type InjectionKey } from 'vue';
import { useDnD, type DnDEvent, type Key } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import {
  KINDS,
  copyEntry,
  createHome,
  createTrash,
  describe,
  folder,
  isFolder,
  items,
  kindOf,
  newId,
  pathTo,
  sizeOf,
  snapshot,
  uniqueName,
  type Entry,
  type FileEntry,
  type FolderEntry,
} from './files';

export type View = 'grid' | 'list';
export type SortKey = 'manual' | 'name' | 'kind' | 'size' | 'modified';

/** The `data` of every folder target: what the overlay says over it. */
export interface DropPlace {
  name: string;
  trash: boolean;
  /** Why the drag can't go in (the folder it is in, a folder into itself), or `null`. */
  why: string | null;
}

/** Photos the browser can show: they get a thumbnail. */
const THUMBNAIL = /^image\/(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|avif|svg\+xml)$/;

const COMPARE: Record<Exclude<SortKey, 'manual'>, (a: Entry, b: Entry) => number> = {
  name: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'en', { numeric: true }),
  kind: (a, b) => KINDS[kindOf(a)].label.localeCompare(KINDS[kindOf(b)].label) || COMPARE.name(a, b),
  size: (a, b) => sizeOf(a) - sizeOf(b),
  modified: (a, b) => a.modified - b.modified,
};

/** "Budget.xlsx" → "Budget copy.xlsx" */
const copyName = (name: string) => name.replace(/(\.\w+)?$/, ' copy$1');

export function createDrive() {
  const { selection, active } = useDnD();
  const home = ref(createHome());
  const trash = ref(createTrash(home.value));
  /** Folder ids, in the sidebar's order. */
  const favorites = ref(home.value.children.slice(0, 3).map((entry) => entry.id));

  // ─── Where we are ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const find = (id: string): FolderEntry | undefined => (id === trash.value.id ? trash.value : pathTo(home.value, id).at(-1));
  const currentId = ref(home.value.children[0]!.id);
  const current = computed(() => find(currentId.value) ?? home.value);
  const inTrash = computed(() => current.value.id === trash.value.id);
  const path = computed(() => (inTrash.value ? [trash.value] : pathTo(home.value, current.value.id)));

  const history = ref<string[]>([]);
  const future = ref<string[]>([]);
  /** Folder being renamed, inline. */
  const renaming = ref<string | null>(null);

  const go = (id: string) => {
    currentId.value = id;
    renaming.value = null;
    selection.clear();
  };
  const open = (target: FolderEntry) => {
    if (target.id === currentId.value) return;
    history.value.push(currentId.value);
    future.value = [];
    go(target.id);
  };
  /** Steps through the history, past folders that are gone meanwhile. */
  const step = (from: string[], to: string[]) => {
    let id: string | undefined;
    while ((id = from.pop()) && !find(id));
    if (!id) return;
    to.push(currentId.value);
    go(id);
  };
  const back = () => step(history.value, future.value);
  const forward = () => step(future.value, history.value);
  const up = () => {
    const parent = path.value.at(-2);
    if (parent) open(parent);
  };

  // ─── What the view shows ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const view = ref<View>('grid');
  const sort = ref<{ key: SortKey; dir: 1 | -1 }>({ key: 'manual', dir: 1 });
  /** Sorts by a column, and by the same one again the other way. Sizes and dates start with the biggest, the newest. */
  const sortBy = (key: SortKey) => {
    const { value } = sort;
    sort.value = value.key === key ? { key, dir: value.dir === 1 ? -1 : 1 } : { key, dir: key === 'size' || key === 'modified' ? -1 : 1 };
  };

  /**
   * The open folder's entries: the grid's `items`. Sorted by a column, folders first;
   * the library writes each drop back through `set`.
   */
  const entries = computed<Entry[]>({
    get: () => {
      const { key, dir } = sort.value;
      const children = current.value.children;
      if (key === 'manual') return children;
      return [...children].sort((a, b) => Number(isFolder(b)) - Number(isFolder(a)) || dir * COMPARE[key](a, b));
    },
    set: (next) => (current.value.children = next),
  });
  const selected = computed(() => entries.value.filter((entry) => selection.has(entry.id)));

  // ─── Undo ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  interface Saved {
    text: string;
    home: FolderEntry;
    trash: FolderEntry;
    favorites: string[];
  }
  const undos = shallowRef<Saved[]>([]);
  /** The toast: the last change, with Undo. `key` restarts its timer. */
  const notice = ref<{ text: string; undo: boolean; key: number } | null>(null);
  let notices = 0;
  const notify = (text: string, undo = false) => (notice.value = { text, undo, key: ++notices });

  /** Called before every change: Undo goes back to this. */
  const record = (text: string, toast = true) => {
    undos.value = [...undos.value, { text, home: snapshot(home.value), trash: snapshot(trash.value), favorites: [...favorites.value] }];
    if (toast) notify(text, true);
  };
  const undo = () => {
    const saved = undos.value.at(-1);
    if (!saved) return;
    undos.value = undos.value.slice(0, -1);
    home.value = saved.home;
    trash.value = saved.trash;
    favorites.value = saved.favorites;
    if (!find(currentId.value)) currentId.value = home.value.id;
    renaming.value = null;
    selection.clear();
    notify(`Undone: ${saved.text}`);
  };

  // ─── Changes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const isTrash = (target: FolderEntry) => target.id === trash.value.id;

  /** Puts `moving` into `target`, renamed where it has the name already. The Trash keeps where they were. */
  const put = (target: FolderEntry, moving: Entry[], from: FolderEntry) => {
    for (const entry of moving) {
      if (isTrash(target)) entry.origin = from.id;
      else delete entry.origin;
      entry.name = uniqueName(target.children, entry.name);
      target.children.push(entry);
    }
  };
  const remove = (from: FolderEntry, gone: Entry[]) => {
    const ids = new Set(gone.map((entry) => entry.id));
    from.children = from.children.filter((entry) => !ids.has(entry.id));
  };

  /** Why the dragged entries can't go into `target`, or `null` when they can. */
  const whyNot = (ids: Key[], target: FolderEntry): string | null => {
    if (target.id === current.value.id) return `Already in ${target.name}`;
    if (pathTo(home.value, target.id).some((step) => ids.includes(step.id))) return 'A folder can’t go into itself';
    return null;
  };
  /** A folder target's `data`, live: the overlay reads it as `over.data`. */
  const placeOf = (target: FolderEntry): DropPlace => ({
    name: target.name,
    trash: isTrash(target),
    why: active.value ? whyNot(active.value.ids, target) : null,
  });

  /**
   * A drop on a folder: in the tree, a tile, a crumb or the Trash. Every drag starts in the
   * open folder, so the dragged entries are in `entries`. Alt copies (`event.mode`), except
   * into and out of the Trash.
   */
  const dropInto = (event: DnDEvent, target: FolderEntry) => {
    const dragged = entries.value.filter((entry) => event.active.ids.includes(entry.id));
    const copying = event.mode === 'copy' && !isTrash(target) && !inTrash.value;
    record(`${copying ? 'Copied' : 'Moved'} ${describe(dragged)} to ${isTrash(target) ? 'the Trash' : target.name}`);
    if (copying) return put(target, dragged.map(copyEntry), current.value);
    put(target, dragged, current.value);
    // The grid lets them go: the library writes the open folder without them.
    event.source?.remove();
    selection.delete(...event.active.ids);
  };

  /** A copy beside the original, "Budget copy.xlsx": Alt-drag in the grid, Duplicate. */
  const duplicateOf = (entry: Entry): Entry => ({ ...copyEntry(entry), name: uniqueName(current.value.children, copyName(entry.name)) });

  const duplicate = (list: Entry[]) => {
    record(`Duplicated ${describe(list)}`);
    const children = current.value.children;
    const copies = list.map((entry) => {
      const copy = duplicateOf(entry);
      children.splice(children.findIndex((child) => child.id === entry.id) + 1, 0, copy);
      return copy;
    });
    selection.set(copies.map((copy) => copy.id));
  };

  const moveToTrash = (list: Entry[]) => {
    if (!list.length || inTrash.value) return;
    record(`Moved ${describe(list)} to the Trash`);
    remove(current.value, list);
    put(trash.value, list, current.value);
    selection.clear();
  };
  /** Back to the folders they were deleted from, or to My Drive when those are gone. */
  const putBack = (list: Entry[]) => {
    record(`Put back ${describe(list)}`);
    remove(trash.value, list);
    for (const entry of list) put(find(entry.origin ?? '') ?? home.value, [entry], trash.value);
    selection.clear();
  };
  const deleteForever = (list: Entry[]) => {
    record(`Deleted ${describe(list)}`);
    remove(trash.value, list);
    selection.clear();
  };
  const emptyTrash = () => {
    record(`Deleted ${items(trash.value.children.length)}`);
    trash.value.children = [];
    selection.clear();
  };

  const rename = (entry: Entry, name: string) => {
    renaming.value = null;
    const next = name.trim().replaceAll('/', '-');
    if (!next || next === entry.name) return;
    record(`Renamed “${entry.name}” to “${next}”`, false);
    entry.name = uniqueName(current.value.children, next, entry);
  };

  const newFolder = () => {
    record('New folder', false);
    const created = folder(uniqueName(current.value.children, 'Untitled folder'));
    current.value.children.push(created);
    selection.set([created.id]);
    renaming.value = created.id;
  };

  // Photos dropped in from the desktop show themselves: their object URLs live as long as the window.
  const urls: string[] = [];
  onScopeDispose(() => urls.forEach((url) => URL.revokeObjectURL(url)));

  const upload = (files: File[], target: FolderEntry) => {
    record(`Uploaded ${files.length === 1 ? `“${files[0]!.name}”` : items(files.length)} to ${target.name}`);
    const added = files.map((file): FileEntry => {
      const url = THUMBNAIL.test(file.type) ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : undefined;
      if (url) urls.push(url);
      return { kind: 'file', id: newId(), name: file.name, size: file.size, modified: file.lastModified, url };
    });
    put(target, added, current.value);
    if (target.id === current.value.id) selection.set(added.map((entry) => entry.id));
  };

  // ─── Favorites ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** The sidebar's sortable list: folders in the Trash leave it. */
  const favoriteFolders = computed<FolderEntry[]>({
    get: () => favorites.value.flatMap((id) => (id === trash.value.id ? [] : (find(id) ?? []))),
    set: (next) => (favorites.value = next.map((entry) => entry.id)),
  });
  const isFavorite = (entry: Entry) => favorites.value.includes(entry.id);
  const toggleFavorite = (target: FolderEntry) => {
    record(isFavorite(target) ? `Removed ${target.name} from Favorites` : `Added ${target.name} to Favorites`, false);
    favorites.value = isFavorite(target) ? favorites.value.filter((id) => id !== target.id) : [...favorites.value, target.id];
  };

  // ─── The window's own state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** The info pane is open. */
  const info = ref(false);
  /** The context menu, where it opened: it acts on the selection, or on the open folder. */
  const menu = ref<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
  /** The folder files from the desktop would go into: the native drop's target. */
  const uploadTarget = ref<string | null>(null);

  return {
    home, trash, current, currentId, inTrash, path, find, isTrash,
    history, future, open, back, forward, up,
    view, sort, sortBy, entries, selected, renaming,
    undos, notice, notify, record, undo,
    whyNot, placeOf, dropInto, duplicateOf, duplicate, moveToTrash, putBack, deleteForever, emptyTrash,
    rename, newFolder, upload,
    favoriteFolders, isFavorite, toggleFavorite,
    info, menu, uploadTarget,
  };
}

const WIDE = 1100;

  observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
    const now = entry!.contentRect.width >= WIDE;
    if (now !== wide) drive.info.value = now;

  });
  observer.observe(root.value!);
});

  if (!picked.length) return count;
  return `${picked.length} of ${count} selected · ${formatSize(picked.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + sizeOf(entry), 0))}`;
});

  drive.menu.value = { x: rect.right, y: rect.bottom + 6 };
};

let toastTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
watch(
  () => drive.notice.value?.key,
  () => {
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(() => (drive.notice.value = null), 6000);
  },
);

  if (event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement || event.target instanceof HTMLSelectElement) return;
  if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'z') {

/** The folders from `root` down to the one with this id, or `[]`. */
export const pathTo = (root: FolderEntry, id: string): FolderEntry[] => {
  if (root.id === id) return [root];
  for (const entry of root.children) {
    const path = isFolder(entry) ? pathTo(entry, id) : [];
    if (path.length) return [root, ...path];
  }
  return [];
};

/** Bytes in a file, or in everything inside a folder. */
export const sizeOf = (entry: Entry): number =>
  isFolder(entry) ? entry.children.reduce((sum, child) => sum + sizeOf(child), 0) : entry.size;

/** "Budget 2026.xlsx", or "Budget 2026 2.xlsx" when the folder has one already. */
export const uniqueName = (siblings: Entry[], name: string, self?: Entry): string => {
  const taken = new Set(siblings.filter((entry) => entry !== self).map((entry) => entry.name.toLowerCase()));
  const dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
  const [base, ext] = dot > 0 ? [name.slice(0, dot), name.slice(dot)] : [name, ''];
  let next = name;
  for (let n = 2; taken.has(next.toLowerCase()); n++) next = `${base} ${n}${ext}`;
  return next;
};

/** A copy with keys of its own, its content too. */
export const copyEntry = (entry: Entry): Entry =>
  isFolder(entry) ? { ...entry, id: newId(), children: entry.children.map(copyEntry) } : { ...entry, id: newId() };

/** The same tree in new objects, keys kept: what Undo goes back to. */
export const snapshot = <T extends Entry>(entry: T): T =>
  (isFolder(entry) ? { ...entry, children: entry.children.map(snapshot) } : { ...entry }) as T;

export const formatSize = (bytes: number): string => {
  if (bytes >= 1e9) return `${(bytes / 1e9).toFixed(1)} GB`;
  if (bytes >= 1e6) return `${(bytes / 1e6).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  if (bytes >= 1e3) return `${Math.round(bytes / 1e3)} KB`;
  return `${bytes} bytes`;
};

const date = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });

export const formatDate = (timestamp: number): string => {
  const days = Math.round((new Date().setHours(0, 0, 0, 0) - new Date(timestamp).setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)) / DAY);
  if (days === 0) return `Today at ${time.format(timestamp)}`;
  if (days === 1) return `Yesterday at ${time.format(timestamp)}`;
  return date.format(timestamp);
};

  // Sorted by a column, the column decides the order: drags only go into folders.
  sort: () => drive.sort.value.key === 'manual',
  // The other picked files wait in place until the drop, as in Finder.
  multiple: 'gaps',
  // Alt-drag leaves the files where they are and drops copies: "Budget copy.xlsx".
  clone: drive.duplicateOf,
  // The whole view takes drops, its empty space too.
  dropzone: area,
  // A function is a functional component: the overlay, told whether it carries rows or tiles.
  overlay: ({ items, over, accepted, status, mode }: OverlayProps) =>
    h(FilesOverlay, { items, over, accepted, status, mode, rows: !grid.value }),
  // A row is as wide as the list: its box is centered on the pointer, and the overlay hangs a chip off it.
  modifiers: () => (grid.value ? [] : [snapCenterToCursor]),
  // Changes no drag made slide and fade too: a new sort, a new folder, files sent to the Trash.
  animateChanges: true,
  onDrop: (event) => {
    // Into a folder, `dropInto` has saved it for Undo; a drop where it was changes nothing.
    if (event.to.index === -1 || !event.result.size) return;
    if (event.mode === 'copy') drive.record(`Duplicated ${describe(event.items)}`);
    else drive.record(`Arranged ${describe(event.items)}`, false);
  },
});

// A press on the empty space draws a band. With Shift, Ctrl or Cmd held it adds to the
// selection (the tiles it crosses flip); without, it replaces it.
let adding = false;
const { isSelecting, style } = makeSelectionArea(area, {
  strategy: () => (adding ? 'toggle' : 'select'),
});
let touch = false;
// On the area, `@pointerdown.capture`: it runs before the band's own listener.
const onPress = (event: PointerEvent) => {
  adding = event.shiftKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
  touch = event.pointerType === 'touch';
};

// ─── Picking ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Where Shift-click and Shift+arrows select from. */
let anchor: string | null = null;
/** The one entry Tab stops at (a roving tabindex): arrows move it. */
const focusId = ref<string | null>(null);
const tabStop = computed(() => items.value.find((entry) => entry.id === focusId.value)?.id ?? items.value[0]?.id);

/** `extend`: from the anchor to `entry` (Shift). `toggle`: add or remove it (Ctrl/Cmd). Otherwise `entry` alone. */
const select = (entry: Entry, { extend = false, toggle = false } = {}) => {
  const ids = items.value.map((item) => item.id);
  if (extend && anchor && ids.includes(anchor)) {
    const [from, to] = [ids.indexOf(anchor), ids.indexOf(entry.id)].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    selection.set(ids.slice(from, to! + 1));
  } else {
    if (toggle) selection.toggle(entry.id);
    else selection.set([entry.id]);
    anchor = entry.id;
  }
  focusId.value = entry.id;
};

const openEntry = (entry: Entry) => {
  // Folders open (not in the Trash, where nothing does); files show their info.
  if (isFolder(entry) && !drive.inTrash.value) drive.open(entry);
  else drive.info.value = true;
};

// A tap opens a folder, as on a phone; a long press picks it up.
const pick = (entry: Entry, event: MouseEvent) =>
  touch && isFolder(entry) ? openEntry(entry) : select(entry, { extend: event.shiftKey, toggle: event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey });

/** The menu acts on the selection: a right click on an entry outside it picks that one. */
const openMenu = (point: { x: number; y: number }, entry?: Entry) => {
  if (!entry) selection.clear();
  else if (!selection.has(entry.id)) select(entry);
  drive.menu.value = point;
};

// ─── Keys ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const focusEntry = (entry: Entry) => {
  focusId.value = entry.id;
  list.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-id="${entry.id}"]`)?.focus();
};

let typed = '';
let typedAt = 0;

const onKeydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  // Space picks the focused entry up (the provider's `keyboard`); the keys of a keyboard drag
  // and of the name being edited aren't ours.
  if (status.value === 'dragging' || event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement) return;
  const all = items.value;
  const at = all.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === tabStop.value);
  const entry = all[at];
  if (!entry) return;
  const mod = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
  const columns = grid.value && list.value ? getComputedStyle(list.value).gridTemplateColumns.split(' ').length : 1;
  const steps: Record<string, number> = grid.value
    ? { ArrowLeft: -1, ArrowRight: 1, ArrowUp: -columns, ArrowDown: columns, Home: -at, End: all.length }
    : { ArrowUp: -1, ArrowDown: 1, Home: -at, End: all.length };

  if (event.key in steps && !event.altKey) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const next = all[Math.min(Math.max(at + steps[event.key]!, 0), all.length - 1)]!;
    // Arrows select as they go, Shift+arrows extend; with Ctrl/Cmd only the focus moves.
    if (!mod) select(next, { extend: event.shiftKey });
    focusEntry(next);
  } else if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    openEntry(entry);
  } else if (event.key === 'F2' && !drive.inTrash.value) {
    selection.set([entry.id]);
    drive.renaming.value = entry.id;
  } else if (event.key === 'Delete' || event.key === 'Backspace') {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (drive.inTrash.value) drive.deleteForever(drive.selected.value);
    else drive.moveToTrash(drive.selected.value);
  } else if (mod && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
    event.preventDefault();
    selection.set(all.map((item) => item.id));
  } else if (event.key === 'Escape' && selection.ids.size) {
    // Handled: the expanded stage around the demo stays open.
    event.preventDefault();
    selection.clear();
  } else if (event.key === 'ContextMenu' || (event.shiftKey && event.key === 'F10')) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const rect = (event.target as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
    openMenu({ x: rect.left + rect.width / 2, y: rect.top + rect.height / 2 }, entry);
  } else if (event.key.length === 1 && !mod && !event.altKey) {
    // Typing a name jumps to it.
    typed = (event.timeStamp - typedAt < 800 ? typed : '') + event.key.toLowerCase();
    typedAt = event.timeStamp;
    const match = all.find((item) => item.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(typed));
    if (match) {
      select(match);
      focusEntry(match);
    }
  }
};

// The focused entry went away (to the Trash, into a folder): its neighbour takes the focus,
// so the keys go on working.
watch(
  items,
  (now, before) => {
    if (!focusId.value || now.some((entry) => entry.id === focusId.value) || document.activeElement !== document.body) return;
    const next = now[Math.min(before.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === focusId.value), now.length - 1)];
    if (next) focusEntry(next);
  },
  { flush: 'post' },
);

const onFocusin = (event: FocusEvent) => {
  const id = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>('[data-id]')?.dataset.id;
  if (id) focusId.value = id;
};

// ─── The list's header ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const COLUMNS: Array<{ key: SortKey; label: string }> = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Name' },
  { key: 'modified', label: 'Date modified' },
  { key: 'size', label: 'Size' },
  { key: 'kind', label: 'Kind' },

    shown.push({ folder, depth });
    if (expanded.value.has(folder.id)) folder.children.filter(isFolder).forEach((child) => visit(child, depth + 1));
  };
  visit(drive.home.value, 0);
  return shown;
});

import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { Drive } from './drive';

/**
 * Files dragged in from the computer's desktop. That is the browser's own drag and drop
 * (HTML5 `dragover` and `drop`), not the library's: it carries files, not elements. The
 * folder under the pointer takes them (a tile, a row of the sidebar, a crumb), else the
 * open folder. Bind the handlers on the window.
 */
export function useDesktopDrop(drive: Drive) {
  /** Files are held over the window. */
  const active = ref(false);

  const carriesFiles = (event: DragEvent) => !!event.dataTransfer?.types.includes('Files');

  /** The folder under the pointer: an element with a folder's `data-id`, else the open folder. */
  const folderAt = (event: DragEvent) => {
    const id = (event.target as Element).closest<HTMLElement>('[data-id]')?.dataset.id;
    return (id && drive.find(id)) || drive.current.value;
  };

  const reset = () => {
    active.value = false;
    drive.uploadTarget.value = null;
  };

  const dragover = (event: DragEvent) => {
    if (!carriesFiles(event)) return;
    // Cancelled, a `dragover` says the drop is welcome here.
    event.preventDefault();
    const folder = folderAt(event);
    // Nothing is uploaded into the Trash.
    const welcome = !drive.isTrash(folder);
    event.dataTransfer!.dropEffect = welcome ? 'copy' : 'none';
    active.value = true;
    drive.uploadTarget.value = welcome ? folder.id : null;
  };

  // Left for good, not for a child element of the window.
  const dragleave = (event: DragEvent) => {
    if (!(event.currentTarget as Element).contains(event.relatedTarget as Node | null)) reset();
  };

  const drop = (event: DragEvent) => {
    if (!carriesFiles(event)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const folder = folderAt(event);
    reset();
    if (drive.isTrash(folder)) return;
    // A dropped folder comes as an empty "file": only real files go in.
    const files = [...event.dataTransfer!.items]
      .filter((item) => item.kind === 'file' && !item.webkitGetAsEntry()?.isDirectory)
      .map((item) => item.getAsFile()!);
    if (files.length) drive.upload(files, folder);
    else drive.notify('Only files can be dropped here, not folders');
  };

  return { active, dragover, dragleave, drop };
}

import { computed, inject, type Ref } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableItem } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import { DRIVE } from './drive';
import { isFolder, type Entry } from './files';
import { useFolderDrop } from './useFolderDrop';

/** What a tile of the grid and a row of the list share: one entry of the open folder. */
export function useFileItem(el: Readonly<Ref<HTMLElement | null>>, entry: () => Entry) {
  const drive = inject(DRIVE)!;

  // `selected` is the provider's selection: drag a selected entry and the others come along.
  const { selected, isDragging } = makeSortableItem(el, { item: entry });

  // A folder takes drops too: in its middle, files go inside.
  const folder = () => {
    const value = entry();
    return isFolder(value) ? value : null;
  };
  const { isTarget, isUploadTarget, gulps } = useFolderDrop(el, folder);

  return {
    selected,
    isDragging,
    /** The folder opens: a drag it takes, or files from the desktop, are over it. */
    isOpen: computed(() => isTarget.value || isUploadTarget.value),
    gulps,
    renaming: computed(() => drive.renaming.value === entry().id),
  };
}

import { computed, inject, ref } from 'vue';
import { makeDroppable, useDnDMonitor, type MaybeElementRef } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import { DRIVE } from './drive';
import type { FolderEntry } from './files';

/**
 * Makes an element take files and folders into `folder` (nothing for `null`): a tree row,
 * a favorite, a crumb of the path, a folder's tile, the Trash.
 *
 * A tile is also an item of the sortable grid. While the grid sorts a drag, the library
 * counts the tile as a target only in its middle; near its edges the grid makes room.
 */
export function useFolderDrop(target: MaybeElementRef, folder: () => FolderEntry | null) {
  const drive = inject(DRIVE)!;

  const { id, isOver, isAccepting } = makeDroppable(target, {
    disabled: () => !folder(),
    // Read live by the overlay as `over.data`: "Move to Photos", or why not.
    data: () => (folder() ? drive.placeOf(folder()!) : undefined),
    // Files of the grid only (not a favorite being sorted), and never where they can't go:
    // a refused tile lets the grid sort over it as over any other.
    accept: ({ active, types }) => types.includes('files') && !drive.whyNot(active.ids, folder()!),
    onDrop: (event) => drive.dropInto(event, folder()!),
  });

  /** Times it took something: each replays the folder's gulp. */
  const gulps = ref(0);
  // The drop is in once its overlay has landed in the folder, the clones one after another.
  useDnDMonitor({
    onDragSettle: (event) => {
      if ('dropped' in event && event.dropped && event.over?.id === id.value) gulps.value++;
    },
  });

  return {
    /** A drag is over it, taken or not. */
    isOver,
    /** A drag it takes is over it: the folder opens. */
    isTarget: computed(() => isOver.value && isAccepting.value),
    /** A drag it refuses is over it. */
    isRefused: computed(() => isOver.value && !isAccepting.value),
    /** Files from the desktop are held over it. */
    isUploadTarget: computed(() => !!folder() && drive.uploadTarget.value === folder()!.id),
    gulps,
  };
}
